title: Loading integer words
statement: For a natural-number word width $W$ and a finite list of integers $w_0,w_1,\ldots$, the memory obtained by loading the list assigns zero to every negative address. At a nonnegative address $a$, it assigns the $W$-bit representation of the $a$th list entry, using zero when the list has no such entry.
hypotheses_covered: the input is a finite list of integers
